_comment: Reference workflow for Pomnia app icon — MCP comfyui-cursor-mcp uses built-in FLUX handler (workflow=flux) when this file is not wired. Export from ComfyUI on ISKRA if you need a custom graph.

_pomnia.post_process: Resize to 512×512 PNG + run scripts/gen-icon.mjs for .ico, or replace resources/ directly

_prompt_positive: Pomnia app icon, abstract brain vault symbol, crescent moon with neural network nodes, flat vector UI icon, violet iris cyan gradient on dark rounded square, minimal geometric, centered, generous padding, soft aurora glow, no text
_prompt_negative: text, watermark, photorealistic, 3d render, light bulb, human, face, hands, glossy skeuomorphic
